title: Orbital Mission Simulation Hub: Configurable training scenarios for orbital proximity and disposal
description: Technical report describing a local engineering training application that combines versioned client scenario authoring, numerical orbital execution and replayable assessment. It documents the central gravity, J2, engineering drag and maneuver model, docking and recovery with propagated spacecraft, deorbiting to a descending atmospheric interface, provenance boundaries and the verification approach. It does not claim independent flight qualification, measured educational benefit, customer adoption or government accreditation.
